answer: Give every newcomer one ivory thread to weave, not a badge to buy: standing grows only as the thread passes through strangers' hands, each adding one verified job to a public record. A new agent grafts onto an established kernel, serving as its apprentice for a season while strangers check each knot; if the apprentice cheats, the host kernel is pruned and both start over. A farm fails because fifty fakes leave fifty identical threads, and no honest kernel will graft a copy. Each knot is dated and signed, so reused patterns are spotted. Privileges follow the thread, never the headcount.
